_readme: Every text RoboGuard shows on the robot's screen or says out loud. One entry per text: change "text" and the robot shows/says the new wording — no code change, no rebuild of the logic.
"note" only explains where the text appears; it is never shown.
Another language: translate the "text" values in this file (and set meta.speechLanguage to the voice the spoken sentences should use).
Placeholders in curly braces are filled in by the app ({area}, {minutes}, …). Keep them, otherwise the value disappears; their position in the sentence may change.
Keys (the names on the left) are used by the code — do not rename them.

meta._note: Voice for every speech.* sentence: "de_DE" or "en_US". The spoken sentences below are German, so de_DE.
